newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech April retail sales down 0.1 pct yr/yr - CSU.
newsitem.headline: Czech April retail sales down 0.1 pct yr/yr - CSU.

text.p: Czech real retail sales fell 0.1 percent in April compared with the same month in 1996, giving growth in the first four months of the year of 0.1 percent over the same period last year, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Monday.
The CSU added that total internal trade in April rose by 3.0 percent year-on-year putting internal trade in the first four months up 2.1 percent compared with the same period in 1996.
